messages:
maya: Orpheus9b bench finished. Need short GTN guidance: default int8 vs opt-in int4 routing. Want a minimal routing flag and quick risk note.

diego: Quick numbers from 50k token smoke: p95 int8=122ms, int4=110ms. Throughput +7% int4. Unit cost est: int8 ~$0.0009/token, int4 ~$0.00058/token (batched + cache assumptions).

lina-qa: QA note: longform QA (>512 tokens) EM drops ~6.4% absolute when converting int8->int4. Hallucination up ~2.1ppt. Short snippets (<=64 tokens) show <1% EM delta. Regression concentrated on retrieval/long-context cases.

sam: Recommendation for GTN: default to orpheus9b-int8. Expose int4 opt-in for short, low-risk flows (<=64 tokens) to capture cost wins. Start int4 canary at 5% on targeted slices.

aj: Operational mitigations: enable KV-cache warmstarts for priming-heavy routes (reduces effective token cost and narrows recall gap). If gap persists, try mixed-per-layer quant (keep first/last layers int8).

diego: Minimal routing flag (proto):
```json
{
  "routes":[
    {"id":"short_optin","match":"tokens<=64 && flow=='low_cost'","model":"orpheus9b-int4","sample_rate":0.05},
    {"id":"default","model":"orpheus9b-int8","sample_rate":0.95}
  ],
  "fallbacks":[{"from":"orpheus9b-int4","to":"orpheus9b-int8","triggers":["quality_drop","latency_spike"]}]
}
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary to eng-dedicated-orpheus at 03:00 UTC (2h window). Auto-rollback if >2% regression on any primary slice or >20% p95 latency increase.

lina-qa: Canary test plan: slices = [short snippets <=64, multi-turn assistant (history 3), longform QA >512]. Metrics: exact-match, hallucination rate, p95 latency, token-cost delta. AB 24h with alerts on EM drop >2% per slice.

diego: I'll open the routing-flag PR with the proto and include the smoke CSV.

maya: I'll monitor canary and call rollback if thresholds hit. Sam, please draft the GTN blurb with expected unit-cost savings and caveats. Lina post CSV once tests complete. Thanks all :thumbsup:
